nodes.name: 0001-runtime-audio-buses-from-project-json.md
nodes.summary: Decides that IvyEngineRuntime loads Master, BGM, SFX, and Voice bus volumes plus uiClickSound from project.json at boot so shipped builds match Project Settings Audio.

nodes.name: 0002-gui-build-playable-package.md
nodes.summary: Defines File → Build Current Project as a full playable package: MSBuild of IvyEngineRuntime and GameScripts, then staging of the renamed host, DLLs, project.json, rom, and current .cso overlays.

nodes.name: 0003-gpu-vertex-shader-skin.md
nodes.summary: Replaces per-frame CPU SkinFromScratch with GPU vertex-shader skinning using the same bind formula, a meshCount×boneCount palette, and CPU-oracle verification until Y Bot positions match.

nodes.name: 0004-runtime-gravity-from-project-json.md
nodes.summary: Applies physics.gravity from project.json in IvyEngineRuntime via the same exe-adjacent lookup as audio buses, so playable packages honor Project Settings Gravity instead of the 9.81 default.

nodes.name: 0005-engine-v1-lock.md
nodes.summary: Accepted 2026-09 lock that tags ivy-engine as engine-v1.0-lock for swing-demo, freezing non-additive engine churn with ScriptRuntimeApi at version 41 until an explicit unfreeze.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses the full Status / Context / Decision / Consequences ADR template; later ADRs in this folder are shorter prose notes.

nodes.name: 0006-first-person-camera-unfreeze.md
nodes.summary: Partially unfreezes ADR 0005 for a parallel first-person camera stack (CameraMode::FirstPerson, FirstPersonCamera_*, CameraDirectorSource::FirstPerson, ScriptRuntimeApi v42) without changing TPS or other frozen surfaces.
